claim_scope: Evidence semantics and administrative readiness only; no human benefit or ARC solve.
exposure_scope: LPHB exposed development; archived representations are historical provenance.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: An empty requested model list prevents administrative work from claiming a new model.
field_principles.acceptance_gates: Source custody, semantic behavior and execution validation remain separate gates.
field_principles.changed_validator_paths: The repair stays at shared readers instead of hiding producer fields.
field_principles.claim_scope: Evidence semantics establishes no judge accuracy, human benefit or ARC result.
field_principles.code_config_hashes: Validation is tied to the exact code and test assertions that ran.
field_principles.current_llm_invocations: Only current owned model operations count as current invocations.
field_principles.current_work_receipts: An empty owned ledger cannot absorb upstream positive model counters.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic elapsed time prevents padding a cheap check to resemble model work.
field_principles.effective_independent_groups: Scripted controls provide no new independent human observations.
field_principles.exposure_scope: Previously exposed LPHB rows remain development evidence.
field_principles.forward_evidence_ready_score: Every semantic control and affected validation must pass before reuse.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Typed gate operands distinguish absent files, absent fields and observed zero.
field_principles.generated_tokens: Forward scoring and artifact validation do not imply token sampling.
field_principles.historical_judge_diagnostic_reference: A diagnostic cannot republish or qualify quarantined science.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal wording prevents missing inputs from becoming retryable partial work.
field_principles.independent_generalization_score: Reusing exposed evidence cannot establish independent generalization.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The CPU artifact audit is explicit and cannot borrow a live model duration floor.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Measured operation type remains separate from historical model activity.
field_principles.model_invocation_counts: Separate load, forward and sampling counters prevent cross-operation negation.
field_principles.original_flag_rows: Immutable original detections remain visible after a reader is corrected.
field_principles.owned_statement_coverage: All new executable statements must be measured with zero exclusions.
field_principles.preserved_detection_rows: Rejecting controls prevent a targeted repair from weakening real detection.
field_principles.random_seed: Fixed control identities prevent outcome-dependent fixture selection.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The replay inputs bind reductions to retained evidence.
field_principles.requested_inference_substrate_class: The declared budget forbids loading a model during this audit.
field_principles.required_checks_passed: Failed affected checks cannot be excused by successful artifact writing.
field_principles.rows: Original control identities retain each attempted administrative unit and its outcome.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: The fixed control roster prevents shrinking the panel after failures.
field_principles.semantic_control_rows: Positive and rejecting fixtures test operational meaning before natural use.
field_principles.source_references: Authenticated snapshots preserve historical authority despite checkout drift.
field_principles.structural_count_derivations: Unique original question groups and floor(TEST/2) prove separate counts.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Normal exits and durable command logs distinguish checks from assertions of checks.
field_principles.validator_hashes: Reader identities make a later code change detectable.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exact administrative controls confer circular validation, not an empirical benefit.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Exact fixture expectations are circular administrative evidence.
